choices.label: Good Old Rock
choices.blurb: When you play Rock, a loss becomes a draw.

choices.label: Sacrifice
choices.blurb: Once per match, declare the round a draw before picking and clear all your marks.

choices.label: Oracle
choices.blurb: Once per match, after both lock in, learn one live move they did not play, then re-pick.

choices.label: Quarantine
choices.blurb: At the start of each round, name a move. If they play it, it takes 4 marks instead of 2.

choices.label: Rust
choices.blurb: Once per match, add 2 marks to a move they currently have live.

choices.label: Chimera
choices.blurb: Your Lizard also beats Scissors, all match.

choices.label: Thief
choices.blurb: Once per match, move one mark from one of your moves onto one of theirs.

choices.label: Ferrus
choices.blurb: Your Robot takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Freeze
choices.blurb: Once per match, their marks don't decrement this round.

choices.label: Second Wind
choices.blurb: The first round you lose is a draw instead.

choices.label: Echo Chamber
choices.blurb: On a drawn round, their move takes an extra mark and yours doesn't.

choices.label: Sharp Practice
choices.blurb: A Scissors mirror is a win for you, not a draw.

choices.label: Grudge
choices.blurb: The move that beat you last round takes an extra mark for them.

choices.label: Tempered
choices.blurb: Your winning move takes 3 marks; your losing move takes 1.

choices.label: Featherweight
choices.blurb: Your Lizard takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Poker Face
choices.blurb: The opponent is never told you have locked in.

choices.label: Blind Spot
choices.blurb: One of your moves has its cooldown hidden from them all match.

choices.label: Small Mercy
choices.blurb: The first round you lose, the move that beat you takes an extra mark for them.

choices.label: Copycat
choices.blurb: On a drawn round, your move takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Bookend
choices.blurb: Your first move of the match takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Old Habits
choices.blurb: You are shown which move the opponent has played most this match.

choices.label: Watchful
choices.blurb: You are shown the opponent's cooldowns as they will stand next round.
